scenes.heading: Building an audience across multiple platforms without spreading thin

sents.d: Building an audience across multiple platforms without spreading thin
One platform-native piece of content, reshaped, beats making five separate pieces from scratch.

Repurposing one core piece of content into platform-appropriate formats (a long-form video becomes short clips, quotes become posts, a post becomes a thread) is far more sustainable than creating entirely separate original content for every platform.
Picking one 'home' platform where you go deepest, and treating others as distribution and discovery channels pointing back to it, avoids the trap of being everywhere shallowly and nowhere strongly.

Not every platform deserves equal effort — tracking which platforms actually convert followers into engaged audience or income, and reallocating time away from ones that don't, is a normal and necessary adjustment over time.

take: Go deep on one platform and repurpose for the rest.
